matches.rationale: No finding discusses relayer gas costs or insolvency caused by many small withdrawals.
Finding 2 is about withdrawId reuse after a message is deleted. It does not cover collisions between 64-bit ids that block legitimate withdrawals, so it is a different defect.
Finding 1 identifies the same missing WITHDRAW_AUTHORITY_ROLE grant in DeployV1, which causes every claim to revert.
